svg.title: What RRF throws away
svg.text: Both losses come from ignoring the scores.
“How much time off do new dads get?”
HOW SURE A RETRIEVER IS GETS LOST
a lead of 2x becomes just “rank 1”: 10 of 30 lookups lose first place
KEEP THE SCORES: A WEIGHTED FUSION
rescale each list to 0..1, then 0.7 × dense + 0.3 × BM25
the weight: chosen by a rule on 46 dev queries (not pre-registered)
15 test questions: RRF 15/15, weighted 15/15 in the top 3
a tie, and only a check: test results were seen while exploring
